actions.description: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Virtual Machine (VM) series F, Fs, Fsv2, Lsv2, G, Gs, Av2, and B are retiring. The VM series are no longer available for use or purchase. Applications and workloads currently operating on VM types must be migrated to newer VM series.
advisor_metadata.displayName: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads
advisor_metadata.label: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads
advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid service disruptions by proactively migrating workloads
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where
    tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_L\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+s$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) startswith "Standard_B" and not(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize endswith "_v2") 
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_A\d+.*_v2$"
| project id, subscriptionId

advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid potential disruptions
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.34' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.34.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.caption: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads
actions.description: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Virtual Machine (VM) series F, Fs, Fsv2, Lsv2, G, Gs, Av2, and B are retiring. The VM series are no longer available for use or purchase. Applications and workloads currently operating on VM types must be migrated to newer VM series.
advisor_metadata.displayName: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads
advisor_metadata.label: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads
advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid service disruptions by proactively migrating workloads
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where
    tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_L\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+s$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) startswith "Standard_B" and not(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize endswith "_v2") 
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_A\d+.*_v2$"
| project id, subscriptionId

actions.caption: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.32 Kubernetes official version
actions.description: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.32 Kubernetes official version

descriptionOfChanges: No Cost Impact
advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.32 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.32 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.32 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.32 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid potential disruptions
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.32' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.32.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id

resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where
    tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_L\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+s$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) startswith "Standard_B" and not(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize endswith "_v2") 
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_A\d+.*_v2$"
| project id, subscriptionId

descriptionOfChanges: No Cost Impact
advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.34 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid potential disruptions
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.34' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.34.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id

| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion)

| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.34'

actions.description: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes official version

descriptionOfChanges: No Cost Impact
advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.34 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid potential disruptions
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.34' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.34.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.description: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Virtual Machine (VM) series F, Fs, Fsv2, Lsv2, G, Gs, Av2, and B are retiring. The VM series are no longer available for use or purchase. Applications and workloads currently operating on VM types must be migrated to newer VM series.
advisor_metadata.displayName: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads
advisor_metadata.label: Review and migrate virtual machine workloads
advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid service disruptions by proactively migrating workloads
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where
    tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_L\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+s$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) startswith "Standard_B" and not(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize endswith "_v2") 
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_A\d+.*_v2$"
| project id, subscriptionId

advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid service disruptions by proactively migrating workloads
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where
    tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_L\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+.*_v2$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+s$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_F\d+$"
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) startswith "Standard_B" and not(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize endswith "_v2") 
    or tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @"^Standard_A\d+.*_v2$"
| project id, subscriptionId

descriptionOfChanges: The Bv2 series does not include temporary (local) storage, enabling lower cost difference and substantial price‑performance gains for workloads that do not require it.
Dldsv5 includes local SSD storage, which increases cost and A2v2.
Esv5 does not include local storage, resulting in a smaller cost increase.
Edsv5 includes local SSD storage, increasing cost
Dldsv5 introduces substantially more local SSD storage and higher performance characteristics, significantly increasing cost.

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Use a Premium SSD managed disk in a Single Instance virtual machine for the highest uptime. Conversion is allowed from a Standard managed disk to a Premium managed disk.
advisor_metadata.displayName: Convert Standard to Premium disk for higher uptime
advisor_metadata.label: Convert Standard to Premium disk for higher uptime
advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Enhanced performance, configurability, and uptime
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
resources 
| where type =~ 'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines' 
| where isnull(properties.availabilitySet.id) and isnull(zones) and isnull(properties.host) and isnull(properties.virtualMachineScaleSet) 
| extend isVMpremiumCapable = iif((tostring(split(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize,'_')[1])) contains "s", 1,0) 
| extend osDisk = iif(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.diffDiskSettings.option == 'Local', 'Ephemeral', properties.storageProfile.osDisk.managedDisk.storageAccountType) 
| where tolower(osDisk) contains 'standard' and isVMpremiumCapable == 1 
| project subscriptionId,id

actions.caption: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.32 Kubernetes official version
actions.description: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.32 Kubernetes official version

descriptionOfChanges: No Cost Impact
advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.32 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.32 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.32 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.32 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.potentialBenefits: Avoid potential disruptions
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.32' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.32.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id
